question: Ustad Akbar Ali Khan is remembered for his contribution to which of the following musical instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarod**__.**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Akbar Ali Khan** is remembered for his contribution to the musical instrument** 'Sarod'.**
 
• He was a renowned Sarod player and contributed to the development of the instrument.
 
• The Sarod is a **stringed musical instrument** that originated in India and is played with a plectrum.
 
• It has a unique sound and is often used in **Indian classical music**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tabla :**

 
 
• Since the **18th** century, the **tabla**, a pair of **small drums**, has been an essential part of Hindustani music in northern **India, Pakistan,** and **Bangladesh**.
 
 
 
• **Santoor:**
 
 
• The Indian** santoor** is a **hammered dulcimer** in the shape of a trapezoid, which is a variant of the Iranian santur.
 
• The instrument typically has **25 bridges** and is constructed of **walnut**.
 
 
 
• **S**itar:**
 
 
• ​It is a** stringed instrument **played in Hindustani classical music that is plucked and originated in the Indian subcontinent.
 
• The instrument originated in **medieval India,** reached its peak of popularity in the **18ₜₕ century**, and evolved into its current form in India during the 19th century.
